title: Panels: one icon strip on the far left opens every panel, several side by side
story: Panels used to live in three places: a left sidebar with History, Infra and Settings tabs, a right-hand slot holding one of Notes, Second Brain, Launch, Work Journal, Workshop or Injector, and a separate right-hand Git panel, each with its own top-bar button plus a sidebar toggle in the project-tab bar. All of that is replaced by one thin icon strip on the far left; panels open beside it, several at once, in the strip's order, and each can be resized. Settings → Features now hides strip icons instead of top-bar buttons, and Keyboard shortcuts lists one Panels group.

checks.criterion: Each icon opens and closes its panel, and open icons are marked
checks.steps: Start Maestro on a window at least 1400 px wide. Click the Notes icon in the left strip, then click it again. Repeat using the panel's ✕.
checks.expected: Notes opens right of the strip with its icon red and a small red bar beside it; a second click or ✕ closes it and clears the mark.

checks.criterion: Several panels sit side by side in strip order
checks.steps: Close every panel. Click Settings, then Notes, then History.
checks.expected: Left to right: History, Notes, Settings.

checks.criterion: Dragging a panel's right edge resizes only it, between 240 and 640 px
checks.steps: Open History and Notes. Drag Notes' right edge far right, then far left.
checks.expected: Only Notes changes width; it stops at about 640 px (or earlier if terminals would drop under 520 px) and at 240 px; History keeps its width.

checks.criterion: A panel that would leave terminals under 520 px does not open; narrowing the window closes the newest panels first
checks.steps: On a window about 1200 px wide open History and Git, then click Notes. Then open Settings, Notes and History and narrow the window to about 900 px.
checks.expected: Notes does not open, its icon shakes and 'No room for Notes. Close a panel or make one narrower.' shows; on narrowing History then Notes close and 'Window got narrower: closed …' names them.

checks.criterion: Open panels and widths come back after a restart
checks.steps: Open Git and Notes, widen Notes, quit Maestro, start it again.
checks.expected: Git and Notes open again with Notes at its new width.

checks.criterion: Every existing panel shortcut opens the same panel
checks.steps: Press Alt+1, Alt+2, Alt+3, Alt+4, Ctrl+2 and Ctrl+5, each twice.
checks.expected: History, Infra, Settings, Injector, Git (on its Status tab) and Notes each open, then close.

checks.criterion: The old sidebar, right panel slot, top-bar panel buttons and sidebar toggle are gone
checks.steps: Look at the project-tab bar, the top bar and the window's right side.
checks.expected: No sidebar toggle; no Notes, Second Brain, Launch, Work Journal, Workshop, Injector or Git buttons up top; no panel on the right.

checks.criterion: Settings → Features chooses which strip icons show
checks.steps: Open Settings, Features → Panel icons, switch off Samurai launch.
checks.expected: The Launch icon leaves the strip and an open Launch panel closes.
